categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill revises the Board of Veterinary Medicine's composition and establishes the scope of practice for veterinary technicians and technologists, specifying which services they may perform under veterinarian supervision versus services reserved exclusively for licensed veterinarians. It also clarifies that veterinarians are responsible for all services performed by their licensed paraprofessional staff.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes registration and regulatory requirements for veterinary professional associates (VPAs), including obtaining certificates of registration from the state regulatory board, public listing of registrants, and grounds for rescission of registration. It also expands telehealth prescription authority for certain drugs.

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes the veterinary professional associate (VPA) as a new paraprofessional category with defined scope of practice, requiring DBPR registration and Board oversight. It sets restrictions on VPA activities while authorizing them to engage in veterinary medicine practice under specific conditions, and expands telehealth prescription authority for certain drugs.

bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
bills.last_action: Died in Industries & Professional Activities Subcommittee
bills.summary_ai: This bill directly regulates veterinary technicians by establishing licensure requirements, scope of practice, continuing education standards, and disciplinary actions. It also defines the relationship between licensed veterinary technicians and supervising veterinarians, including what responsibilities can be delegated.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)
bills.regulatory_type: scope of practice, licensure, continuing education, delegation, discipline, title protection

bills.title: An Act Authorizing Certain Foreign-educated Veterinarians To Practice Under A Temporary Permit And The Establishment Of A Veterinarian-client-patient Relationship Through The Use Of Telehealth For The Treatment Of Urgent Medical Conditions.
bills.summary_ai: This bill expands veterinary services access by allowing foreign-educated veterinarians to practice under temporary permits and enabling telehealth for urgent conditions. While primarily focused on veterinarians, it indirectly affects paraprofessionals by potentially changing supervision requirements and practice settings where they work.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning Credit Cards And Health And Veterinary Care Services.
bills.summary_ai: This bill restricts veterinary care providers from advertising, promoting, or assisting consumers in obtaining medical credit cards, and prohibits charging for services before delivery or ancillary products without consent. It affects all veterinary paraprofessionals who work in practices that handle client billing and financial transactions.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning State Law Protections For Health Care Providers And Patients Related To The Provision Of A Legally Protected Health Care Activity.
bills.summary_ai: This bill extends state law protections for health care providers and patients regarding legally protected health care activities. Depending on implementation, it could protect veterinary paraprofessionals performing authorized clinical duties and establish legal safeguards for both practitioners and animal owners.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Sunset Pet Animal Care & Facilities Act
bills.summary_ai: This bill concerns the continuation and licensing of pet animal care facilities under state agricultural regulation, implementing recommendations from a 2025 sunset review. Veterinary paraprofessionals working in these facilities would be affected by licensing standards, facility requirements, and regulatory oversight established through this legislation.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Access to Veterinary Care
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses veterinary care access through multiple mechanisms including expedited licensure for veterinarians, clarification of prescription and compounded drug usage, and a drug donation program. While primarily focused on veterinarian licensure and drug regulations, it impacts the paraprofessional workforce by potentially affecting scope of practice, supervision requirements, and delegation of drug-related tasks to veterinary technicians and assistants.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: cat declawing.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 479, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California's veterinary medicine regulations to restrict or prohibit cat declawing procedures, which directly impacts the clinical tasks and procedures that veterinary paraprofessionals can perform or assist with in practice. The legislation modifies the scope of permissible veterinary procedures under the healing arts regulations.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Criminal history information: background checks.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 313, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends multiple state codes to establish or modify criminal history background check requirements across various licensed professions and regulated industries. Veterinary paraprofessionals may be affected if background check provisions are included in the Business and Professions Code sections amended (particularly Section 4606 which relates to veterinary licensing).
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Antimicrobial resistance.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Res. Chapter 103, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses antimicrobial resistance, which is a critical issue in veterinary medicine where paraprofessionals play a key role in medication administration, client education, and infection control practices. Veterinary paraprofessionals are directly involved in implementing antimicrobial stewardship protocols and preventing resistance through proper drug handling and use practices.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants: scope of practice.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 371, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends state law to define and potentially expand the scope of practice for registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants. It directly addresses what tasks and procedures these paraprofessionals are legally permitted to perform in veterinary medicine.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 205, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California's veterinary medicine regulations by modifying multiple sections of the Business and Professions Code and adding new sections related to veterinary practice. The amendments likely address scope of practice, licensure requirements, and regulatory oversight for veterinary professionals and paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians: veterinarian-client-patient relationship.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State. Chapter 589, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends veterinary medicine regulations regarding the veterinarian-client-patient relationship, which is a foundational legal requirement that defines what services veterinarians can provide and delegate to paraprofessionals. Changes to this relationship standard directly impact the scope of practice and permissible delegations for veterinary technicians, technologists, nurses, and assistants.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: California Veterinary Medical Board.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 195, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This California bill comprehensively amends the Veterinary Medical Board regulations across multiple sections of the Business and Professions Code, affecting licensing, scope of practice, supervision requirements, and disciplinary procedures for veterinary professionals. The amendments likely impact paraprofessional workforce regulations including technicians, assistants, and other support personnel through changes to delegation authority, supervision ratios, and practice standards.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act For The Department Of Education - Division Of Higher Education Appropriation For The 2026-2027 Fiscal Year.
bills.last_action: Notification that SB58 is now Act 138
bills.summary_ai: This appropriations bill allocates funding to the Department of Education's Division of Higher Education for fiscal year 2026-2027, which directly impacts the availability of educational programs and training pathways for veterinary paraprofessional workforce development. Funding decisions affect the capacity and quality of veterinary technician, technologist, nurse, and assistant training programs at community colleges and universities.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary practices; ownership; oversight
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses veterinary practice ownership and oversight requirements, which directly impacts how veterinary paraprofessionals work within clinical settings and who can employ them. The legislation may establish scope boundaries, supervision requirements, and operational standards that affect all categories of veterinary support staff.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Animal abuse; animal neglect; classification
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes legal classifications and definitions for animal abuse and neglect, which directly impacts veterinary paraprofessionals' professional responsibilities and mandatory reporting obligations. Veterinary paraprofessionals frequently encounter suspected animal abuse or neglect cases and must understand these legal definitions to properly identify and report such situations.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; education alternative; certifications
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses veterinary technician education pathways and certification requirements, establishing alternative routes for individuals to become qualified veterinary technicians and obtain professional certifications. It directly impacts the credentialing and qualification standards for veterinary paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; certification; education alternative
bills.last_action: House LARA Committee action: Held, voting: (0-0-0-0-0-0)
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses certification and education alternatives for veterinary technicians, directly impacting how paraprofessionals can enter and practice in the profession. It modifies pathways to becoming a certified veterinary technician by allowing alternative educational routes alongside traditional programs.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Statewide Spay & Neuter Program
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a statewide spay and neuter assistance program and fund, which will likely increase demand for spay and neuter surgical procedures performed in veterinary clinics. Veterinary paraprofessionals will be involved in supporting these procedures through surgical assistance, anesthesia monitoring, and post-operative care.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Professional Licensing; Temp Permits
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses temporary professional licenses for certain professions, which could apply to veterinary paraprofessionals seeking to practice while completing licensure requirements or during credential transitions. Temporary permits would allow qualified individuals to work in veterinary roles before obtaining full professional credentials.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Extnd Bds:midwive/nursing/vet Exam/parole
bills.last_action: EFFECTIVE DATE(S) OF LAW SEE CHAPTER
bills.summary_ai: This bill extends the termination date of the Board of Veterinary Examiners, which is the regulatory body responsible for overseeing veterinary professionals including paraprofessionals. The extension ensures continued oversight and regulation of veterinary technicians, technologists, nurses, and other veterinary paraprofessionals through their examination and licensure processes.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Professional Licensing; Temp Permits
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses temporary professional licenses, which could allow veterinary paraprofessionals to practice under provisional credentials while completing licensure requirements or during workforce shortages. The temporary permit mechanism may expand access to veterinary paraprofessional services and provide pathways for credential holders to begin practice before full licensing is obtained.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Disaster Emergency Plan For Pets
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a disaster emergency plan for pets and service animals in Alaska, specifically involving veterinarians and veterinarian technicians in emergency response coordination. The legislation addresses how veterinary paraprofessionals would be integrated into state and local emergency planning committees during disaster situations.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Emergency Med Svcs; Operational Canines
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses emergency medical services for operational canines (working dogs) and modifies veterinary practice laws regarding emergency treatment, liability protections for veterinarians, and potentially the scope of duties that emergency responders and veterinary professionals can perform in canine emergencies.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Health care; allied health professionals, training; tuition grants and loan forgiveness; Rural Allied Health Professional Workforce Expansion Act and Rural Clinical Training Partnership Fund created
bills.last_action: Pending House Ways and Means General Fund
bills.summary_ai: This bill creates funding mechanisms including tuition grants and loan forgiveness for allied health professionals in rural areas through the Rural Allied Health Professional Workforce Expansion Act. Veterinary paraprofessionals working in rural clinical settings would be eligible for these financial support programs to address workforce shortages.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine; veterinarian-client-patient relationship further specified; scope of practice inside and outside veterinarian-client-patient relationship further defined
bills.summary_ai: This bill clarifies the veterinarian-client-patient relationship (VCPR) and defines the scope of practice for veterinarians both within and outside this relationship. These definitions directly impact what tasks can be delegated to veterinary paraprofessionals and the supervision requirements for their work.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)
